topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I can’t believe it’s happening. They’ve transferred me to another department, just like that. I spent years building my reputation here, becoming an indispensable part of the team. Now, I’m supposed to start anew, prove myself all over again. The new department is known for its cutthroat culture, where everyone is out to make a name for themselves. I’m not sure I have the energy for this. It feels like every step forward is being countered by two steps back. I know I have to make the best of it, but the thought of going through all the uncertainty again is overwhelming. I just need to find my footing, somehow.
